g.text: Left: improve the recipe at fixed load. Right: choose the load for the final recipe.
C12 streams faster; C16 has more throughput. Both improve on their own baselines.
Lines join known loads, not a complete frontier. Reference concurrency is not fully matched.
Speed = 1/P90 TPOT; total includes cached history. Endpoints and TTFT use part 1 readings.
